articles.title: 'Hocus Pocus' Tops Disney+ as Halloween Nears
articles.summary: The 1993 Halloween movie 'Hocus Pocus' is the No. 1 movie on Disney+, and a third film in the series is in the works.

articles.title: Replaying 'Kingdom Hearts': A Fan Misses the Final Fantasy Friends
articles.summary: A Kotaku writer replaying 'Kingdom Hearts' wishes the series would again feature 'Final Fantasy' characters as much as the first game did.

articles.title: 'VisionQuest' Takes a Side in a Big 'WandaVision' Debate
articles.summary: In Episode 3 of Marvel's 'VisionQuest,' Vision gives his view on Wanda's actions in 'WandaVision,' a topic fans have long debated.
